prompt: My team uses VS Code with multiple project folders open simultaneously. I'm getting significant performance slowdowns when working on deeply nested React components; suggest extensions or configuration changes for improved stability across several projects.
chosen: Install the 'Prettier' and 'ESLint' extensions; configure them with appropriate rules for React. Limit open projects to reduce memory load.
rejected: That sounds frustrating! Working across multiple projects can definitely impact performance, especially with complex React components. Perhaps installing extensions like Prettier or ESLint could help streamline your code and maybe improve things? I think you could also look at VS Code's configuration settings; limiting the number of open project folders might alleviate some strain on your system. It’s worth investigating these options to see if they make a difference!
